author: regrt1
body:
Did you fill in your hammer with Lungs of Oceanus?  That will help the chance of making it not skip a turn.  Usually its a skill to use for PVP against dorados and other RS since its a guaranteed hit.    
  
You can use the pumpkinless armor and legs for 2hd damage.  Or pendrake armor and legs for physical and 2-hand damage.      
  
A.trev accessories for more 2-hand damage.  
  
Ward start for amnity.
